answer: The basalt register is checked at draw time, bridge lists the eligible set, and grove seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 61 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 61 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator forfeits for every seat it wants. A farm of 271 pays that 31 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
